source_scope: All 112 main/README.md files fetched and reviewed in this pass; 92 existing records enriched from 2026-11-20 umbrella inventory. This is a README-level portfolio audit, not a source-code, branch, CI, security or deployment audit.
association_policy: Each repository receives two proposed associative links: an operational complement and a cross-domain value-creation route. Links are strategic hypotheses, not verified runtime dependencies.
principles: Do not create duplicate repositories when an existing canonical domain can be extended.
Keep one authority per fact: identity, accounting, settlement, model inference, execution, risk and governance.
Separate proposal, authorization, execution, settlement, accounting and external realized value.
Public-sector workflows require lawful data access, procurement neutrality, auditability, privacy, accessibility and human appeal.
Every new integration must become a versioned contract with conformance tests before being called an executable dependency.
